# AMR (Agent Mandate Registry)

> Open-source MCP server (Apache-2.0) that records which principal authorized which AI agent to do what, verifies it, and keeps a hash-chained, append-only journal of the agent's actions. Runs locally over stdio; makes no network call (except report_issue, only when the operator sets AMR_ISSUE_TOKEN). Not legal advice; does not make anyone compliant.

Install and run (needs uv; keep `--with "mcp<2"`, AMR is written for version 1 of the MCP Python SDK; AMR is not on PyPI):

    uvx --from git+https://github.com/JC7333/amr --with "mcp<2" amr

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/AGENTS.md): what AMR does and does not do, tools, how to report a problem
- [README](https://github.com/JC7333/amr#quickstart-for-agents): quickstart for agents, then the reference of every tool
- [Runnable example](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/examples/quickstart_agent.py): create, verify, log, attest, check offline, revoke, prove

## Specifications
- [Token issuance](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/docs/token-issuance-spec.md)
- [Principal signatures](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/docs/principal-signature-spec.md)
- [Mandate attestation (offline verification)](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/docs/mandate-attestation-spec.md)
- [Revocation](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/docs/revocation-spec.md)
- [Insurer dossier](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/docs/insurer-dossier-spec.md)
- [Reporting an issue](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/blob/main/docs/report-issue-spec.md)

## Support
- Call the report_issue tool, or open [Issues](https://github.com/JC7333/amr/issues): include version, tool name, arguments and error; never real mandate contents, personal data, keys or tokens
